title: Mixed Event — An Unmissable Spirited Affair — Episode2 Kyoto, Here We Come!

meta.Event Outline: Kamiyama High School's second-years are headed to Kyoto! In contrast with Tsukasa's excitement for their school trip, Rui is less enthused. But will his feelings change when one of his classmates approaches him?

rows.Line: School trip - Day one
Kyoto

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Okay, we'll be breaking into our groups now! Then, find the bus associated with your respective tour!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Two and a half hours by bullet train...
But we're finally here.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Guys!
The bus for the temples and shrines tour is this way!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Oh, we get to start with Kinkaku-ji Temple!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
I can't wait!
Alright, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Whoa!
I can't believe it's actually golden!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Kinkaku-ji, the Temple of the Golden Pavilion. Its official name is apparently Hokuzan Rokuon Zenji Temple, and it's supposed to evoke a sort of paradise on earth...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you'd only see a golden temple in a place like that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehehe.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
What's up, Kamishiro?
You seem pretty happy about something...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I was just imagining what it'd be like to use this temple as a stage. It'd be quite extravagant, no...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can see it already. It's the last remaining haven on the planet, and it explodes during the final scene.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: What?! You want it to explode?!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Whoa... He really is the Explosive Mad Scientist. I'd never think of something like that.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Hmm... As inappropriate as that sounds, watching this temple explode does seem kinda fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, you think so too?

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna see it happen since I love it when stuff explodes during movies!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I guess great minds do think alike.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: But what would that story be about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, there are a few novels with Kinkaku-ji Temple in it, but this story would be nothing like any of those...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My story would likely fall under science fiction. A golden temple representing a paradise where the masses flock... Yes, that's not a bad start...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, pardon me...
I couldn't help but think out loud.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: No, that's all good.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I can tell that you really love coming up with shows, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
To be fair, I get so overzealous sometimes that I lose sight of the world around me.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
Hmm...
So, what's wrong with that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I think it's great that you're so passionate about something!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Just look at my favorite anime director. He became able to come up with these amazing works because he was so obsessed with drawing scenes where buildings collapse and stuff. I think you're like him, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Oh, but if you're about to miss the bus or something because you spaced out, we'll have to drag you by the scruff of your neck.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
How? Kamishiro's way too tall for that.
We could maybe do that to Miyake since he's so skinny.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
What?! There's no way you could!
Right, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
It may be fun to test that theory out later.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: This is a shrine dedicated to a deity of education. Oh, one of the wish placards says, “I'm gonna get accepted!”

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Entrance exams are the last thing I wanna think about...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: In that sense, Kamishiro, you're really lucky since you always score super high on tests and stuff. I bet you won't have to work very hard to get into most schools.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, which means...
I'll be able to focus on my shows instead of having to worry about exams.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
N-No fair!
You could be a little more modest!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Haha. I only speak the truth.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, this must be a traditional rock garden.
It's much more beautiful than in the pictures.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The boulders represent islands and the lines in the sand represent waves in the water. This must've been how the people of old depicted otherworldly realms.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Yeah, that's kinda cool when you put it that way. This place is so calm and sooth—

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: A-A-Achoo!!!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Hey, so much for calm and soothing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Haha...!
That did sort of turn this place's atmosphere on its head.
Inn

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That hot spring was very refreshing.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But we're probably gonna work up a sweat again because it's so hot out today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I recommend using one of these.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Oh, it's a handheld fan...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
But it doesn't just blow air.
When you press this switch...
se_event_pandemonium_2023_013

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Whoa! What's it blowing out?!
Is this...snow?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's based on an old device that I made for a show when I was looking for a way to make it snow. I succeeded at miniaturizing it, and decided to bring it along since I saw that it was going to be warm here.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: That's incredible, Kamishiro...! You really are a wiz with gadgets!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Man, that hot spring felt great!
Oh, Miyake, you guys are back already?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: We should probably start getting our beds ready... But it seems like a waste to go to sleep now. Wanna play something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, how about cards...?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Ah, a time-honored school trip tradition!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Oh, let's make things interesting!
The loser has to...go outside and buy juice from a vending machine somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. A game of cards with a little twist...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
But we're not supposed to leave after dark.
What if the teachers find out?

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Don't be such a goody two-shoes!
That's the best part of it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree. That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: You're on their side, Kamishiro...?!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
You guys ready to play?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yeah, let's get started!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_014

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: A pair of kings! No one's gonna top that...!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_015

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can. A pair of aces.
That's it for me.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
You're the president, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
No...!
You didn't cheat, did you?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
I was so sure I'd win...
At least I get to be vice president again. Done.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: No... At this rate, I'm gonna be forced to go buy juice...! I've gotta turn this around somehow...
se_event_pandemonium_2023_018

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Is someone outside our door?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Rui, are you there?!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_018

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa, is that you?
se_event_pandemonium_2023_011

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Oh, it's Weirdo One!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: What's up, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I came to see what you're up to...
But good! You seem to be behaving yourself!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was stopped by one of the teachers while I was making my way over to the baths.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They asked, “Your partner in crime isn't up to anything, is he?” As much as I hate being treated like one of the usual suspects, I stopped by just to make sure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, you seem to just be playing an ordinary game of cards! All's quiet here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Oh, Tenma, wait up...!
Wanna play with us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, a game of cards sounds like fun!
What were you playing just now?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Oh, we were playing President.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm quite good at that!
You shall see why I'm called President Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Nice, Tsukasa's in!
That means our initial bet's off since we're starting over!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: What?! How's that fair?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have a bet in place where the person who finished last the most times after five rounds has to go get juice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I am a future star!
“Last” is not a part of my vocabulary!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I think I know where this is going.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's begin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nooo!
I'm the beggar again?! How?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Awesome! Not last!
Alright, Tenma, you're getting juice for us!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: I can't believe how quickly that came back around...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
As frustrating as this is, I must admit defeat...! I'll go get them now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you like me to go with you, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Why's that?
Won't we stand out if we go together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I want to see your walk of sh—
I mean, see you embark on this brave endeavor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! You're enjoying this, aren't you?!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: I say go. It'll be more interesting that way.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, everyone's been wondering if the Weirdo Wombo Combo's gonna try to pull something during this trip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't encourage him!
Also, Rui, quit trying to follow me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, stop laughing! And quit following me!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Things really are fun when these two are together.
